event.description: Union closest shared FF-output scalar groups 5 and 251
event.proposal: Family: parameter tying. Current retained frontier is 1,722 parameters at 99.010000%, a +0.010000 percentage-point margin over 99%. There have been 27 prior macro-attempts in this family and 388 prior micro-trials. The most recent accepted result is attempt-0085/micro-0002 at 1722 parameters and 99.010000%; the most recent failed result is attempt-0081/micro-0007 (discard, 98.970000%). This is a parameterization-preserving compression of the depth-shared feed-forward output map: union flattened coordinates 5 and 251, values -0.0478998274 and -0.0478938483 (difference 5.979e-06), using a weighted mean and integer reconstruction. Hypothesis: residual-stream reconstruction contains near-duplicate scalars distinct from FF-input redundancy, preserving qualification at 1,721 parameters. It is more informative than the next FF-output union (difference 7.624e-06) because it is the minimum-distortion isolated test of the complementary FF map. Official acceptance and rollback are unchanged.
